messages: Alice Chen: Hey team — customer hitting a 400 on embeddings intermittently. They say sometimes they send a single string and sometimes an array, and sometimes an empty string sneaks in. Error: "Bad Request: embedding vector length 1 != expected 1536". Posting the minimal curl they used: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-xxx' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"text-embedding-1536", "input": "a short sentence"}'``` They say wrapping as a string sometimes works (for single) but other clients send `["a short sentence"]` and then it works. Any quick checks? :thinking:
messages_continued: Ben (support): Thanks Alice. That error happens when the server parses the input as a single scalar and ends up producing a 1-dim vector (or the client accidentally serializes a string that becomes a single-character token). Can you ask for the raw request/response pair from the customer (headers + body)? Also confirm Content-Type and that the client isn't double-stringifying. Common pattern: sending JSON with input set to a stringified JSON payload e.g. ""[\"text\"]"" leads to odd shapes.
messages_followup:
Alice Chen: Customer pasted a snippet. They have a helper that does `if (!Array.isArray(input)) input = JSON.stringify(input)` — so sometimes it ends up as `"text"` or `"["text"]"`. They also reported a spike in latency and a couple 400s. Attached response: ```HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
Content-Type: application/json
{ "error": "Invalid input: embedding dimension 1 != expected 1536" }```
messages_advice: Ben (support): Suggested steps to customer: 1) Ensure Content-Type header is exactly application/json. 2) Always send `input` as an array for batching: "input": ["text1", "text2"]. 3) Run `typeof input` and `Array.isArray(input)` before stringify. 4) If using a SDK, upgrade to latest which normalizes singleton inputs. 5) Share a HAR/curl when you still see 400s. I'll create a ticket if they can share request_id from response headers.
messages_bot: ingest-bot: ticket #SUP-3821 created for customer 'acme-inc' referencing the 400 dimension errors. Labels: embeddings, client-encoding, urgent. Assigned to Ben (support).
messages_closing: Jordan M.: One more tip — some frameworks send form-encoded payloads by default. If Content-Type is application/x-www-form-urlencoded the server will try to coerce values and you can get strange shapes. If they report latency spikes, ask for request timestamps and `x-redwood-request-id` from responses so infra can correlate. :mag:
messages_signature: Alice Chen: Thanks — passing tips to the customer. Will attach repro and HAR via the ticket. :thumbsup:
